Sandbox_Narrador.Activado_tooltip: Turns the automatic storyteller on or off. Admins can still start stories by hand from the right-click menu.
Sandbox_Narrador.DiaInicio_tooltip: In-game day from which the storyteller may start events.
Sandbox_Narrador.HorasEntreEventos_toolt: In-game hours the storyteller waits after starting one story before it may start another.
Sandbox_Narrador.MaxActivos_tooltip: How many stories can be open at the same time.
Sandbox_Narrador.MultiplicadorZombis_too: Scales every zombie wave the storyteller spawns. 100 = as written.
Sandbox_Narrador.Conversaciones_tooltip: Narrator NPCs talk to each other when someone is nearby (and sometimes ask for your opinion).
Sandbox_Narrador.Reputacion_tooltip: Each group earns trust with each missionary by completing jobs: ranks, more offers, more precise maps and favors.
Sandbox_Narrador.ReputacionBloqueaUltra_: If enabled, Louisville ULTRA jobs unlock at 70 trust with that missionary.
Sandbox_Narrador.Encuentros_tooltip: People asking for help while you explore new areas of the map.
Sandbox_Narrador.Indicadores_tooltip: All: arrow (isometric) or compass (first person) and map marks. Map only: no arrow or compass. Hard: no world map zones either.
Sandbox_Narrador.EstiloNarrador_tooltip: Calm: rests after big events. Balanced: normal. Relentless: frequent events, few breaks. Erratic: unpredictable.
Sandbox_Narrador.Dificultad_tooltip: Scales hordes, bandits and runners in every story and threat.
Sandbox_Narrador.Amenazas_tooltip: Periodic threats sized by days survived, character skills and how many players are together. Players far apart get separate, lighter threats.
Sandbox_Narrador.HorasEntreAmenazas_tool: Average game hours between threats (adjusted by narrator type).
Sandbox_Narrador.Escalado: Scaling by days, players and skills
Sandbox_Narrador.Escalado_tooltip: Story waves grow with days survived, player count and skills.
Sandbox_Narrador.Rumores_tooltip: Before some stories, characters talk about what is coming.
Sandbox_Narrador.EventosEstacion_tooltip: Holidays, power outage, storms, fog and heat.
Sandbox_Narrador.Ocupaciones_tooltip: If someone takes anything from a police station, gun store, military base, hospital, pharmacy, grocery or mall, a few days later bandits live there (no zombies, burnt cars, bodies and graffiti). Kill them and others arrive 20 days later.
Sandbox_Narrador.DesbloqueoMisioneros_to: Each missionary shows up after you help them clear their building to set up a camp. If off, they are there from the start.
Sandbox_Narrador.HistoriaConRefugio_tool: Stories, missionaries, rumors and events start once someone claims a safehouse (or marks a house as base in A-Life). If off, they start right away.
